lifestage.quote: Для кошек и котят с 6-недельного возраста

texts.about_this_item: Beaphar Vit Bits are crunchy cat treats filled with a tasty multi-vitamin paste — a perfect snack for any occasion. They contain added taurine, which supports good eyesight and a healthy heart, and a balanced complex of B vitamins that helps prevent nutrition-related problems such as hair loss, skin problems and a dull coat. For cats and kittens from 6 weeks of age; suitable for pregnant and nursing cats. Contains no GMOs. 35 g (about 75 pieces).
texts.ingredient_information: Composition: cereals, milk and milk derivatives, oils and fats, meat and animal derivatives, yeasts, minerals. Analytical constituents: protein 31%, crude fibre 2.8%, fat 10%, ash 3.4%, moisture 9%, calcium 0.15%, phosphorus 0.62%, sodium 0.17%, potassium 0.54%, magnesium 0.13%. Additives per kg: vitamin A 4580 IU, vitamin B1 58 mg, vitamin B2 17 mg, pantothenic acid 2.8 mg, nicotinamide 160 mg, biotin 62 mcg, taurine 660 mg, antioxidants, colourants.
texts.feeding_instructions: Give as a preventive supplement or as a reward. Daily: cats under 3 kg — 1–5 pieces; 3–6 kg — 5–10 pieces. Not for animals younger than 6 weeks. Always provide enough fresh drinking water. Store in the closed original pack in a dry place out of reach of children at 15–25 °C.

review_note: New product (Vit Bits ≠ Malt/Catnip/Cat-a-dent Bits). Both photos are the same EN/RU pack from two shops.
